newsitem.title: USA: Galey sees Q2 EPS near low end $0.32-$0.40.
newsitem.headline: Galey sees Q2 EPS near low end $0.32-$0.40.

text.p: Galey & Lord Inc said Friday that results for the March quarter 1997 will likely fall short of the average estimates that analysts have currently projected for the company for the period.

Arthur Wiener, chairman and chief executive, "earnings per share for March quarter 1997 will likely be near the lower end of the range of $0.32 to $0.40 per share currently estimated by stock analysts."

Weiner said the decline in projected earnings is primarily due to manufacturing inefficiencies caused by increasing production rates to maximum levels so as to meet higher customer demand for its products.
The company said it however expects the quarter's sales and earnings to be up significantly from the March quarter 1996 results.

Weiner said the company's order backlog continues at all-time highs, "in fact...higher than year-ago orders in every business line." The company previously reported that the backlog at December 28, 1996 was $167 million, up 84 percent against the previous year's $91 million.
Galey & Lord manufactures cotton and cotton-blended apparel fabrics and fabrics used in home furnishings, including comforters, bedspreads and curtains.
